## Model Details

This model is an MXFP4 (mixed MXFP4 experts / MXFP8 linear) model of [zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash) generated by [intel/auto-round](https://github.com/intel/auto-round) using RTN. Please follow the license of the original model.

- **Quantized (MXFP4)**: routed experts
- **Kept in BF16**: router / embeddings / lm_head

## How to Use

### Environment

```bash
uv pip install --index-strategy unsafe-best-match \
    --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/9815732c16ca076c60b65fccd787167d6a9c5328/cu130 \
    "vllm==0.29.1rc1.dev528+g9815732c1"
uv pip install --no-build-isolation \
    git+https://github.com/vllm-project/DeepGEMM.git@e1f418c2a4f20818221f6b0e578b4c2f634d4c3f
```

### vLLM Usage

```bash
vllm serve intel-ai/GLM-5.3-Flash-MXFP4-Mixed-CT-AutoRound \
    --block-size 128
```

## Evaluation

| Benchmark | BF16 | MXFP4 | Recovery |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GSM8K | 97.35 | 97.35 | 100.00% |
| MMLU | 86.66 | 85.81 | 99.02% |
| PIQA | 82.92 | 83.13 | 100.25% |
| HellaSwag | 69.03 | 68.36 | 99.03% |
| **Average** | **83.99** | **83.66** | **99.61%** |

## Generate the Model

```bash
auto-round \
    --model_name zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash \
    --model_free \
    --scheme MXFP8 \
    --ignore_layers "lm_head,eh_proj,shared_head,enorm,hnorm,indexer,mlp.gate." \
    --layer_config "{mlp.experts:{bits:4,data_type:mx_fp}}" \
    --format llm_compressor \
    --output_dir GLM-5.3-Flash-MXFP4-Mixed-CT-AutoRound
```

## Ethical Considerations and Limitations

The model can produce factually incorrect output, and should not be relied on to produce factually accurate information. Because of the limitations of the pretrained model and the finetuning datasets, it is possible that this model could generate lewd, biased or otherwise offensive outputs.
Therefore, before deploying any applications of the model, developers should perform safety testing.

## Caveats and Recommendations

Serving requires `glm5_next` support and DeepGEMM; vLLM 0.29.0 cannot load this architecture. The environment above fixes a compatible source-era build; the exact vLLM commit used for the reported evaluation was not published.

Users (both direct and downstream) should be made aware of the risks, biases and limitations of the model.
Here are a couple of useful links to learn more about Intel's AI software:

- [Intel Neural Compressor](https://github.com/intel/neural-compressor)
- [AutoRound](https://github.com/intel/auto-round)
